entities.name: Gilberto Hernández Guerrero

entities.summary: Gilberto Hernández Guerrero is a Mexican chess grandmaster. On the July 2008 FIDE rating list he has an Elo rating of 2550, making him the second highest ranked player on the Mexican ELO-list. He was the highest ranked Mexican player in most of the 1990s and 2000s.
